requirements.requirement: The system must render a pass badge when triage status is 'pass' and a fail badge when triage status is 'fail'.
The system must display the specialty match explanation as the first visible reasoning element in the triage component.
The system must render reasoning sections in the order provided by the frontend prioritization logic (specialty first, then quality).
The system must provide an expandable UI control for each reasoning section that toggles visibility of detailed explanations.
The system must default expandable reasoning sections to a collapsed state except for the specialty match explanation, which must be visible by default.
The system must render triage components within the existing MessageBubble layout without breaking existing chat message rendering.
The system must support reusable component props that accept triage data conforming to the schema defined in EVAL-P-TRIAGE-UX-S1.
The system must visually distinguish pass and fail states using consistent color or icon indicators aligned with existing UI patterns.
The system must render partial or intermediate triage states (e.g., partial match) with a distinct visual indicator if provided in the data.
The system must handle missing specialty explanation data by displaying a fallback message indicating unavailable information.
The system must handle empty or missing reasoning sections by rendering a minimal component with only pass/fail badge and a fallback explanation.
The system must prevent rendering failures by safely handling null or undefined triage data inputs without crashing the UI.
The system must allow multiple triage components to be rendered in a single chat view without visual overlap or layout breakage.
The system must ensure expandable sections maintain state (expanded/collapsed) during user interaction within the same session.
